ConnectedApp.label: Skywave Heroku Relay
ConnectedApp.description: Single Skywave integration Connected App (consolidated 2026-06: the former Skywave_DataCloud_Integration + Skywave_DC_Ingest were folded in). Serves THREE flows off one app + one keypair: (1) JWT-bearer for the Heroku skywave-app relay (subscribes to Demo_State_Change__e via Pub/Sub, fans events to phones over WebSocket); (2) JWT-bearer for the Tier-5 Data Cloud / tracking scripts (scripts/datacloud/*.py via SF_CLIENT_ID + secrets/jwt.key); (3) client_credentials for the data360 MCP (cdp_query_api / cdp_ingest_api). The public cert below is paired with secrets/jwt.key. POST-DEPLOY in App Manager (not deployable as metadata): add the cdp_query_api + cdp_ingest_api scopes, enable Client Credentials Flow with a run-as user, and fetch the consumer secret once (→ .secrets/dc.env for the MCP). See SECRETS.md and SKYWAVE_INTERACTIVE_DESIGN.md.
